title: Color Flow
tagline: Warped noise edges through CRT and snow
dsl:
search synth, filter, render, points, mixer, classicNoisedeck

let osc1 = osc(type: oscKind.saw)
let osc2 = osc(type: oscKind.noise, min: 0.65, max: 0.9, seed: 4220)

noise(
  type: catmullRom3x3,
  octaves: 1,
  scaleX: 100,
  scaleY: 1,
  loopOffset: verticalScan,
  loopScale: 100,
  speed: -100
)
  .seamless(repeat: 1)
  .translate(y: osc1)
  .posterize(
    levels: 16,
    gamma: 0.7,
    _skip: true
  )
  .wormhole(
    kink: 0.1,
    stride: 2,
    rotation: -22
  )
  .edge(
    size: kernel7x7,
    amount: 500,
    mix: 0
  )
  .subchain(name: "lens effects", id: "c9dk") {
    .snow(alpha: 0.86, density: 9.93)
    .chromaticAberration(aberration: 13.6, passthru: 74.69)
    .crt(alpha: 0.57)
    .bloom(
      threshold: 0.75,
      softKnee: 0.11,
      intensity: 0.55,
      taps: 32
    )
    .lens(displacement: -0.5)
    .vignette(brightness: 0.26, alpha: 0.72)
    .motionBlur()
    .smooth()
  }
  .adjust(saturation: 0.83, contrast: 0.82)
  .write(o0)

render(o0)
